result.title: Counting What Matters: Reducing Redundant Object Detections in Overlapping UAV Mapping Imagery for Disaster Response
result.comment: 9 pages, 6 figure, IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics, SSRR 2026, Incheon, Korea, November 02-04, 2026
result.summary: UAV mapping flights enable rapid aerial reconnaissance of large-scale incident sites in civil protection. However, the image overlap required for orthophoto generation causes every physical object to be detected multiple times across images, while dynamic objects may be omitted from or duplicated in the resulting orthomosaic. Analysis based on the orthophoto alone is therefore structurally insufficient. We address this by detecting objects on the individual images and merging redundant detections across them. This task lies between multi-object tracking and re-identification, as mapping flights form temporally ordered but sparsely sampled sequences with object reappearances across flight strips. We fine-tune YOLO detectors on a new domain-specific nadir dataset from real civil protection operations, roughly doubling mAP50 over the previous system, and propose re-identification approaches based on 3D positions from sparse reconstruction, DINOv3 appearance embeddings, and their combination via constrained greedy clustering. %On four manually annotated real-world mapping flights, the combined weighted multi-pass approach achieves the best trade-off between association accuracy and count error. On four manually annotated real-world mapping flights, an association-only evaluation using ground-truth detections shows that the combined weighted multi-pass approach provides the best trade-off between association quality and count error. It is integrated into the open-source web application ARGUS and visualized as verifiable, correctable object groups for first responders. https://github.com/RoblabWh/argus

AI.brief_summary: 针对无人机测绘影像重叠造成同一目标被多次检测的问题，先在单幅图像上检测，再用稀疏重建得到的 3D 位置与 DINOv3 外观嵌入做重识别，并以约束贪婪聚类合并冗余检测，服务于灾害响应中的目标计数。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于遥感目标检测与跨视图重识别/去重，不涉及 VLM 内部表示、latent 推理状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
